correctness.rationale: PASS: Using the source's explicitly cited Asgarli–Duan–Lai Proposition 4.8, q=4 and characteristic 2 fix the normalized gradient of a maximal-degree smooth Frobenius-nonclassical sextic. The derivative-free degree-six difference is precisely a cubic G(x²,y²,z²) in 10 independent F4 coefficients; no scalar duplicates survive normalization. All three derivatives vanish simultaneously at exactly the 21 points of PG(2,F4), so geometric smoothness iff F is nonzero at those 21 points, with no untested algebraic-closure singularities. A separately authored F4 enumerator traversed all 4^10=1,048,576 coefficients and found exactly 960 smooth; a separately implemented orbit traversal under explicit invertible projective generators reached all 960 and orbit-stabilizer gives |PGL3(F4)|/960=63. The representative's nonzero rational evaluations and no-F4-points statement also follow. This is exhaustive finite arithmetic supporting an exact finite classification, not extrapolation. Inspected actual source files RESULT.md, verify_cpp.cpp, verify_python.py; the latter's code, not merely expected logs, was reviewed.
